about_the_game:
Dig For Riches – Journey to the Depths of the Underground

⛏ Dig, haul, sell… but remember: every strike has its price.
As you descend beneath the surface, the darkness closes in, the air grows heavy, and each blow takes you deeper. Dig For Riches offers a realistic mining simulation experience – dig meters into the earth, extract valuable ores, haul your load to the surface, and increase your profits.

🌌 Endless Depth

Each new dig takes you a little further from the surface.

  • Realistic digging and ore extraction

  • Discovering and collecting valuable resources

  • Hauling loads with minecarts and selling them

  • Increasing risk and reward with every descent

⚒ The Mining Cycle

  • Dig – Break soil and rock with shovel and pickaxe.

  • Collect – Sort ores and valuable minerals.

  • Haul – Load your cart and push it along the rails.

  • Sell & Upgrade – Use your earnings to improve your equipment and dig deeper.

💎 Progression & Strategy

Upgrade as you earn:

  • Mining speed and power

  • Excavation radius

  • Energy capacity

  • Radiation resistance

  • Health and explosive power

☢ Hazards & Survival

  • Radiation zones – Enter unprepared and your health will quickly drain.

  • Dynamite – Opens large areas but can be deadly if mishandled.

  • Energy management – When energy runs out, mining stops; replenish with food and drinks.

📜 Missions & Extra Content

  • Take on jobs from the Sheriff NPC, find the requested items, and deliver them.

  • Earn special rewards and rare items.

  • Play token-based mini-games to hit targets and earn extra income.

🎮 Simulation Experience

Dig For Riches delivers mining in its purest and most realistic form.
Dig the earth, haul your load, upgrade your gear, and venture deeper.
The deeper you go, the greater the risk – and the greater the reward.

💬 Are you ready? The depths are calling… grab your shovel and start digging.

content_descriptors.notes: During exploration, you may come across skeletons and old body remains in certain areas. These are placed to support the atmosphere and do not contain overly disturbing details.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
